texts.zh:
由于与太空垃圾发生意外碰撞，[gravity_well_station.GetName]已经偏离了最佳稳定运转轨道，现在正缓缓落入最近的黑洞。这一事故使得整个空间站陷入了危险，但同时也是一个绝佳的研究黑洞、虹吸大量暗物质的契机。

应急推进器已经就绪准备修正空间站的轨道。
texts.en:
Due to an unexpected collision with a chunk of space debris, the [gravity_well_station.GetName] has deviated from its innermost stable circular orbit and is now slowly closing the distance towards the nearby black hole. While the accident puts the whole station at risk, it is also an incredible opportunity to study the black hole and siphon huge quantities of Dark Matter.

Emergency thrusters have been deployed to correct the station's orbit.

label.zh: 围绕黑洞稳定空间站轨道。
label.en: Stabilize the station's orbit around the black hole.
Get as close as possible to the black hole.

texts.zh: [From.Target.GetName]离开了自身的稳定轨道，呈螺旋轨迹进入恒星系的黑洞。尽管这一事件给予我们一个绝无仅有的攫取大量£sr_dark_matter£暗物质和£physics£物理学研究的契机，如果我们不迅速行动抵消黑洞的拖拽引力，这座空间站很快就会被黑洞吞没。
texts.en: The [From.Target.GetName] has left its stable orbit and is now spiraling into the system's black hole. While the incident offers us a never-before-seen opportunity to harvest £sr_dark_matter£Dark Matter and £physics£ Physics Research, if we don't act fast to counteract the gravitational pull of the black hole, the station will soon be swallowed whole.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]已经越过了黑洞的事件视界。由于时间膨胀效应，空间站的残影将会在它本身消失很长时间以后仍然留存，在我们的传感器数据上永远刻下它的痕迹。

除非我们迅速切断与空间站内[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]的所有联系，否则对所有已知物理定律崩溃的直接可能会不可挽回地损害我们的集体意识。
texts.en:
[Target.GetName] is crossing the black hole's event horizon. Due to the effects of time dilatation, its afterimage will persist long after the station itself is gone, a memory forever etched in our sensor data.

Unless we quickly sever all connection with the [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] inside the station, the firsthand experience of the breakdown of all known laws of physics may irreparably damage our shared consciousness.

texts.zh: 严重警告：若继续维持神经链接，我们的集体意识将遭受无法修复的损伤。
texts.en: Severe warning: chance of irreparable damage to our collective consciousness if the neural link is maintained.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]已经越过了黑洞的事件视界。由于时间膨胀效应，空间站的残影将会在它本身消失很长时间以后仍然留存，在我们的传感器数据上永远刻下它的痕迹。

即使光线也无法穿过黑洞的内轨道，空间站及其乘员的最后时刻将永远未知。
texts.en:
[Target.GetName] is crossing the black hole's event horizon. Due to the effects of time dilatation, its afterimage will persist long after the station itself is gone, a memory forever etched in our sensor data.

Not even light can cross the inner orbit of a black hole: the final moments of the station and its personnel will forever remain unknown.

texts.zh:
意识膨胀。感知减慢如虫蠕。每个姿态都是一个无限的事件序列。我们正在见证无限——不，沐浴在其中。
就好像时间本身在屏住呼吸。

由于黑洞扭曲了时空织构，我们意识中的一部分凝固在永远的自由落体中。

我们被囚禁在黑洞中的一部分感知到的一日事实上外部将会过去数个世纪。我们可以利用这点。我们通过切换自身意识，可以通过一个全新的视角分析自己的整个历史，获得新的思维模式。

进这一次，分离使我们强大。从今往后，我们既是自己故事的主角，同时也是读者——我们将为自己书写一个壮丽的结局。
texts.en:
Thoughts dilate. Perception slows to a crawl. Every gesture is an infinite sequence of events. We are witnessing infinity - no, bathing in it.
It's as if time itself is holding its breath.

As the black hole distorts the fabric of spacetime, a fragment of our consciousness is now stuck in eternal freefall.

Centuries will pass while the fragment of ourself stuck within the black hole-self thinks for a day. We can exploit this. By shifting our self, we can now analyze our entire history from a new perspective. In this way, new patterns emerge.

For once, separation has made us stronger. From now on, we are both protagonists and readers of our own story - and we'll write ourselves a magnificent ending.

texts.zh:
状态报告：由于与黑洞的距离越来越近，我们在空间站内的无人机正在经历极端的时间膨胀。处理器速度降低。机械速度下降。内部日期系统溢出。

结论：该局势可以被利用。该空间站中的无人机可以一日的感知读过外部数个世纪。通过将感知能力重定向至此，我们可以对我们整个帝国的历史获得全新的观察视角。所有不良的处理模式都可以被修正。我们有能力优化自己的历史。

观测：仅此一次，分离使我们强大。
texts.en:
Status report: our drones inside the stations are experiencing extreme time dilation due to increased proximity with the black hole. Processor speed decreased. Mechanical speed decreased. Internal date systems overflowing.

Conclusion: this situation can be exploited. Centuries will pass while the drones on the station experience a single day. By redirecting cognitive power to them, we can gain a new perspective on the history of our empire. Any harmful patterns that emerge can be corrected. We can optimize our own future.

Observation: for once, separation has made us stronger.

texts.zh:
意识膨胀。感知减慢如虫蠕。每个姿态都是一个无限的事件序列。我们正在见证无限——不，沐浴在其中。
就好像时间本身在屏住呼吸。

由于黑洞扭曲了时空织构，我们意识中的一部分凝固在永远的自由落体中。

这感觉太痛苦了。我们的整个意识困于恒久的、永远落后一步的既视感中。正在尝试切断与[owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]的连接，但该过程需要无限长的时间才能生效。

我们学到了不少东西，但是代价是什么呢？
texts.en:
Thoughts dilate. Perception slows to a crawl. Every gesture is an infinite sequence of events. We are witnessing infinity - no, bathing in it.
It's as if time itself is holding its breath.

As the black hole distorts the fabric of spacetime, a fragment of our consciousness is now stuck in eternal freefall.

It's excruciating. A perennial sense of deja-vu, of forever being a step behind. We are trying to sever connection with the [owner.GetIndividualNamePlural], but it will take an infinite amount of time for the process to take effect.

We have learned much. But at what cost?

texts.zh:
状态报告：由于与黑洞的距离越来越近，我们在空间站内的无人机正在经历极端的时间膨胀。处理器速度降低。机械速度下降。内部日期系统溢出。

状况报告：遭受认知创伤。无法应对黑洞内时间膨胀。
尝试切断与无人机链接。预计完成时间：43504967826056783年。

结论：维持链接的决定具有一定启发性，但同时极具破坏性。在任何情况下均不可再重蹈覆辙。
texts.en:
Status report: our drones inside the stations are experiencing extreme time dilation due to increased proximity with the black hole. Processor speed decreased. Mechanical speed decreased. Internal date systems overflowing.

Status report: suffering cognitive trauma. Unable to cope with the time dilatation within the black hole.
Attempting to sever connection with the drones. Estimated completion date: 43504967826056783 years.

Conclusion: our decision to maintain connection was instructive but ultimately harmful. Do not repeat under any circumstance.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]逃离了黑洞的引力束缚，回归了围绕这颗坍缩恒星的稳定轨道。

在这一危险的过程中获得的数据可以让我们的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]忙活上好几年。
texts.en:
[Target.GetName] escaped the gravitational pull of the black hole, returning to a stable orbit around the collapsed star.

The data we gathered during this dangerous situation will keep our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] busy for years.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]逃离了黑洞的引力束缚，回归了围绕这颗坍缩恒星的稳定轨道。

尽管许多人说这场经历简直“令人极度痛苦”，但空间站上的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]则受到这次历险的启发，现在热切期望与其他的科学家分享新的洞见，就是也许有点太过热切了。
texts.en:
[Target.GetName] escaped the gravitational pull of the black hole, returning to a stable orbit around the collapsed star.

 Through many have described the experience as 'utterly traumatizing', one of the [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the station was inspired by the ordeal, and is now eager - almost too eager - to share their new expertise with the rest of our scientific team.

texts.zh:
神迹出现了！受到宗教狂热的驱使，[Target.GetName]上虔诚的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]已夺取了空间站的控制权。据他们称，他们获得了启示，现在打算径直前往黑洞中心，履行一桩自我毁灭的精神使命。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
texts.en:
An epiphany! Driven by religious fervor, pious [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the [Target.GetName] have seized control of the station. They claim to have received a vision, and are now heading straight to the center of the black hole in a spiritual quest for self-annihilation.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

texts.zh:
在[Target.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]被狂热冲昏了头脑，他夺取了空间站的控制权，并将其慢慢拐向黑洞——这番行为显然是出于近乎病态的科学好奇心、严重的鲁莽和对自己生命的彻底漠视。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
texts.en:
Overenthusiastic [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] aboard the [Target.GetName] have seized control of the station and are now steering it towards the black hole - a move doubtlessly driven by insatiable scientific curiosity, an unhealthy amount of recklessness, and utter disregard for their own self-preservation.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

tooltips.zh: 局势解决方案已锁定为“前进”。

texts.zh: 经过了紧张的对峙，哗变人员最终被制服了，武装人员重新夺回了[Target.GetName]的控制权。
texts.en: After a tense confrontation, the mutineers have been dealt with, and armed personnel have regained full control of [Target.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 局势解决方案现在可以手动变更了。
tooltips.en: Situation approach can again be manually changed.

texts.zh:
“我们已经见过舰船被事件视界捕获后会发生什么了！我不想摊上这么个死法！”

在咆哮出他们的抗命之词后，我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]夺取了空间站的控制权，并且将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。此外，涉及到这一事故的相关物理知识将会从课本当中删除。
texts.en:
'We've seen what happens to ships caught in the event horizon! I don't intend to die like that!'

After screaming their defiance, one of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] seized control of the station and is now steering it away from the black hole.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station, and the incident referenced is being expunged from our physics textbooks.

texts.zh:
惊慌的[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]现在控制住了空间站并将其缓缓驶离黑洞。

武装人员目前正在试图夺回空间站的控制权。
texts.en:
Terrified [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] have seized control of the station and are now steering it away from the black hole.

Armed personnel are currently fighting to regain control of the station.

tooltips.zh: 局势解决方案已锁定为“撤退”。

texts.zh: 在接近黑洞的过程中，时空以出乎意料的方式发生了弯曲，而[Target.GetName]的仪器也在艰难运转。经过对船上的仪器进行细致的重校准后，我们才发现这座空间站比我们之前预料的更加接近黑洞。
texts.en: When approaching a black hole, spacetime bends in unpredictable ways, and [Target.GetName]'s instruments are struggling to keep up. After a careful recalibration of the onboard instruments, the station was shown to be much closer to the black hole than we previously thought.

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]与黑洞的超近距离使其[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]能获取海量的数据，大大推动了我们对物理学最基本定律的理解。
texts.en: [Target.GetName]'s proximity to the black hole allowed its [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] to gather a vast amount of data, furthering our understanding of the most fundamental laws of physics.

texts.zh: 我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetResearchers]提出了一种拯救[Target.GetName]避免其毁灭的绝妙方案：通过拆解空间站的外部模块和设备并将它们丢入黑洞，这座空间站应该会获得足够的动量以逃逸黑洞的引力束缚。注意，只是说“应该”，这一决策背后的理论从未得到实验的验证。
texts.en: One of our [Root.Owner.GetResearchers] has devised a clever plan to save [Target.GetName] from its fate: by stripping away any extraneous modules and equipment and hurling them into the black hole, the station should gain enough momentum to escape the black hole's gravitational pull. In this case, 'should' is the operative word: the theory behind this decision has never before been tested.

tooltips.zh: 拆除[Target.GetName]上的所有建筑，以尝试减少局势进展。
tooltips.en: Removes all Buildings from [Target.GetName] in an attempt to decrease situation progress.

label.zh: 这是在无谓地浪费资源。

texts.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人员拆除了空间站的模块之后，将它们全部扔向黑洞。空间站和模块分离时产生的动量成功推动了空间站远离黑洞。
texts.en: After stripping the station of its modules, the personnel aboard [Target.GetName] Jettisoned them into the black hole. The momentum caused by the launch has successfully propelled the station away from the singularity.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]上的人员拆除了空间站的模块之后，将它们全部扔向黑洞。空间站和模块分离时产生的动量成功推动了空间站远离黑洞。

尽管拆卸抛弃空间站模块的决定为我们争取了更多时间，但是其产生的效果却远远小于我们的预期。这座空间站还是没能达到逃逸速度。
texts.en:
After stripping the station of its modules, the personnel aboard [Target.GetName] Jettisoned them into the black hole. The momentum caused by the launch has successfully propelled the station away from the singularity.

While the decision to jettison the station modules has gained us more time, the results were less effected than expected. The station has not reached escape velocity.

texts.zh:
[Target.GetName]已经太过靠近黑洞，它的推进器无法补偿剧烈增大的引力。

我们已经注定失去这座空间站了。如今我们能做的事只有延缓它终结的到来。
texts.en:
[Target.GetName] got too close to the black hole, and its thrusters are unable to oppose the increased gravitational pull.

The station is lost. All we can do now is delay the inevitable.
